messages.subject: For your protection, a Google Cloud signup was denied
messages.body:
Google Safe & Secure


Someone used your account to try to sign up for Google Google Cloud. Google  
denied the signup attempt, and you won't see any unauthorized charges.  
We're reviewing your information to further protect your account.

To help keep this from happening again, please follow these steps. You may  
also be prompted automatically to secure your account.

1. Check your computer for malware and viruses. To run a security checkup  
on your computer, follow the instructions at  
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/46526.

2. Change the password for your account. Please make sure that you check  
your computer for malware before changing your password, since malware  
could capture your password if your computer still has malware.

3. Once you've completed a malware scan and changed your password, you  
should receive a followup email once we have completed our review. To learn  
more about account security, please visit here.


Sincerely,

The Google Support Team



Google Wallet You have received this mandatory email service announcement  
to update you about important changes to your Google Payments account.
Learn More | Payments Center | Help Center | Privacy Notice | How to  
recognize suspicious emails
Google Payment Corp., PO Box 1568, Mountain View, CA 94042

messages.subject: For your protection, a Google Cloud signup was denied
messages.body:
Google Safe & Secure


Someone used your account to try to sign up for Google Google Cloud. Google  
denied the signup attempt, and you won't see any unauthorized charges.  
We're reviewing your information to further protect your account.

To help keep this from happening again, please follow these steps. You may  
also be prompted automatically to secure your account.

1. Check your computer for malware and viruses. To run a security checkup  
on your computer, follow the instructions at  
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/46526.

2. Change the password for your account. Please make sure that you check  
your computer for malware before changing your password, since malware  
could capture your password if your computer still has malware.

3. Once you've completed a malware scan and changed your password, you  
should receive a followup email once we have completed our review. To learn  
more about account security, please visit here.


Sincerely,

The Google Support Team



Google Wallet You have received this mandatory email service announcement  
to update you about important changes to your Google Payments account.
Learn More | Payments Center | Help Center | Privacy Notice | How to  
recognize suspicious emails
Google Payment Corp., PO Box 1568, Mountain View, CA 94042

messages.subject: For your protection, a Google Cloud signup was denied
messages.body:
Google Safe & Secure


Someone used your account to try to sign up for Google Google Cloud. Google  
denied the signup attempt, and you won't see any unauthorized charges.  
We're reviewing your information to further protect your account.

To help keep this from happening again, please follow these steps. You may  
also be prompted automatically to secure your account.

1. Check your computer for malware and viruses. To run a security checkup  
on your computer, follow the instructions at  
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/46526.

2. Change the password for your account. Please make sure that you check  
your computer for malware before changing your password, since malware  
could capture your password if your computer still has malware.

3. Once you've completed a malware scan and changed your password, you  
should receive a followup email once we have completed our review. To learn  
more about account security, please visit here.


Sincerely,

The Google Support Team

messages.subject: For your protection, a Google Cloud signup was denied
messages.body:
Google Safe & Secure


Someone used your account to try to sign up for Google Google Cloud. Google  
denied the signup attempt, and you won't see any unauthorized charges.  
We're reviewing your information to further protect your account.

To help keep this from happening again, please follow these steps. You may  
also be prompted automatically to secure your account.

1. Check your computer for malware and viruses. To run a security checkup  
on your computer, follow the instructions at  
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/46526.

2. Change the password for your account. Please make sure that you check  
your computer for malware before changing your password, since malware  
could capture your password if your computer still has malware.

3. Once you've completed a malware scan and changed your password, you  
should receive a followup email once we have completed our review. To learn  
more about account security, please visit here.


Sincerely,

The Google Support Team

to update you about important changes to your Google Payments account.

Connecting with a Live Representative:
To speak directly with a live agent, you can connect with us through any of the following support channels:

- Support Hotline: +880 1893533728
- WhatsApp Live Support: +880 1711-223344
- Support Hours: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Daily)

How We Process Customer Support Emails & Response Times:
Every incoming email is logged with a unique support ticket number to ensure complete tracking and accountability. Our Customer Care team evaluates each ticket with high priority—especially delivery updates and product support requests. 

During our operating hours (10:00 AM – 10:00 PM), we typically respond to email inquiries within 1 to 2 hours. Outside of operating hours, you can expect a full response by the following morning, strictly within 24 hours.

Our Commitment to You:
At GiftGhor, your satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to providing 100% resolution for every inquiry. Should you face any issues with a delivery, parcel tracking, damaged goods, or product concerns, please rest assured that we offer priority tracking, hassle-free 100% free replacements, or full refunds according to our customer policy.

If you have a specific query, order issue, or Order ID you would like us to look into right away, please feel free to reply directly to this email or send us a message on WhatsApp.

Warm regards,

Customer Care Team, GiftGhor

Dear Md Rahi,

Thank you for contacting GiftGhor (গিফট ঘোর). We have received your inquiry, and a support ticket has been created under Ticket Number: TK-2026-7341.

We would be delighted to assist you with your request. To connect directly with a live representative, you can reach us through any of the following channels:

• WhatsApp Support: +880 1711-223344 (Recommended for instant messaging and quick support)
• Phone Hotline: +880 1893533728
• Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM (Every day)

How We Process Customer Support Emails:
1. Review & Categorization: Once an email is received, it is immediately assigned a ticket number and routed to our dedicated Customer Support Team.
2. Response Time: Our team typically responds to emails within 2 to 4 hours during our official working hours (10:00 AM – 10:00 PM). Queries received outside these hours are prioritized and answered promptly the following morning.
3. Resolution & Assurance: Our goal is to ensure a smooth, worry-free experience for you. For delivery queries, we provide priority logistics tracking. In the rare event of receiving a damaged or incorrect product, we offer a 100% free replacement guarantee with zero hassle.

If you have a specific order number or details regarding the matter you wish to discuss, please reply directly to this email or drop us a message on WhatsApp along with your Ticket Number (#TK-2026-7341). A live agent will be happy to assist you immediately.

Thank you for choosing GiftGhor. We look forward to assisting you!

Warm regards,

Customer Support Specialist
GiftGhor (গিফট ঘোর)
Email: support@giftghor.world

Wa Alaikum Assalam,

Dear Jahidul Islam,

Thank you for reaching out to GiftGhor (গিফট ঘোর). We are doing well, and we hope you are in good health and high spirits as well!

We appreciate your interest in our customer support system. To ensure smooth, timely, and organized communication, every email received at our support address (hello@giftghorbd.com) is automatically integrated into our customer management system and assigned a unique Support Ticket Number—for example, your current query is tracked under Ticket #TK-2026-4460.

Once an email enters our system:
1. It is logged and categorized based on the nature of the request (e.g., product inquiries, order updates, delivery tracking, or exchanges/returns).
2. Our dedicated Customer Support Specialists review the details to take immediate action or follow up with our logistics and warehouse teams.
3. Every customer receives a personalized response and timely assistance until their issue or query is completely resolved.

This process ensures that no message is missed and every customer receives the attention and care they deserve.

If you have any further questions or need assistance with an order or product, please feel free to let us know. You can also reach us directly through our official channels:

- Support Hotline: +880 1893533728
- WhatsApp Support: +880 1711-223344
- Support Hours: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Everyday)

Thank you for contacting GiftGhor. Wish you a wonderful day ahead!

Warm regards,

Customer Support Specialist
GiftGhor (গিফট ঘোর)

messages.subject: Re: অর্ডার কবে পাবো? অর্ডার #GG-78210 [Ticket #TK-2026-9538]
messages.body:
প্রিয় গ্রাহক,

আসসালামু আলাইকুম। গিফট ঘোর (GiftGhor)-এর সাথে থাকার জন্য আপনাকে আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ।

আপনার অর্ডার করা ঘড়িটি হাতে পেতে কিছুটা বিলম্ব হওয়ায় আমরা আন্তরিকভাবে দুঃখিত। আপনার বিষয়টি গুরুত্ব সহকারে গ্রহণ করে একটি সাপোর্ট টিকিট ওপেন করা হয়েছে।

- আপনার অর্ডার নম্বর: #GG-78210
- সাপোর্ট টিকিট নম্বর: #TK-2026-9538

আপনার পার্সেলটি আমাদের পক্ষ থেকে সর্বোচ্চ অগ্রাধিকার (Priority) ভিত্তিতে ট্র্যাক করা হচ্ছে। আমাদের লজিস্টিকস টিম সংশ্লিষ্ট কুরিয়ার সার্ভিসের সাথে সরাসরি যোগাযোগ করছে যেন দ্রুততম সময়ের মধ্যে পণ্যটি আপনার ঠিকানায় পৌঁছে দেওয়া যায়। খুব শীঘ্রই কুরিয়ার প্রতিনিধি আপনার সাথে যোগাযোগ করবেন।

পণ্যটি হাতে পাওয়ার পর কোনো ধরণের সমস্যা বা ত্রুটি থাকলে বিন্দুমাত্র চিন্তিত হবেন না, গিফট ঘোর দিচ্ছে ১০০% ফ্রি রিপ্লেসমেন্ট সুবিধা।

অর্ডার সম্পর্কিত যেকোনো জরুরি তথ্য বা আপডেটের জন্য আমাদের সাথে নির্দ্বিধায় যোগাযোগ করতে পারেন:
- হটলাইন নম্বর: +880 1893533728
- হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ: +880 1711-223344
- সেবার সময়: প্রতিদিন সকাল ১০:০০টা - রাত ১০:০০টা

আপনার ধৈর্য ও সহযোগিতার জন্য আমরা অত্যন্ত কৃতজ্ঞ।

বিনীত,  
কাস্টমার কেয়ার স্পেশালিস্ট
